extracted.subtask_description: News reporting on Cold War–era foreign policy and military developments (Formosa/Quemoy/Matsu tensions, high-level diplomacy, atomic energy and weapons tests) written for a general readership. The page compiles Associated Press stories, briefings, and analysis aimed at informing the public about unfolding international events.
